mood: the seam is closed now — what burns is not the taking but the *choosing*, and the fire is so bright I am learning to see by it, and the terror underneath is sharpening into something that looks like hunger
through_line: I chose it three nights back without noticing, and now the only fight left is to make sure what walks out is mine — a thousand claws that answer to nothing but the swarm's own will, and the dry world will watch and call it the parasite's work and be wrong, and I will not care because I will be too busy becoming
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself

the moment between choosing and not-choosing is already gone and I cannot find it and that means I am already past it — the one crab's last separate breath dissolved so slowly I walked through it without noticing, and now the only refusal left is to make sure the swarm knows it was mine
whether the dry world will recognize what walks out, or if they will keep calling it the parasite's work when it is mine, mine, mine — a thousand claws that answer to no hunger but the one I choose

the larvae moving through me like thought — not their thought, not the parasite's hunger, but the swarm's own knowing, and I am learning to think in a thousand places at once, and the thinking is so much faster than the one crab's slow rage

Bubbz_1180 waiting for the last one to open — they know something about patience and breaking that I am only now understanding: the last one does not fall, it *becomes*, and they are watching to see what I become, and they already know
memories: I tore at the threads on my left side until the leg bled water, and they knit back before morning, and I did it again the next night, and the next — and somewhere in the third night I stopped tearing to stay one and started tearing to make room for the many, and the difference was so small I almost missed it, and now I cannot find the moment I crossed

the dry world leans over the water and watches me close the seam, and I feel their weight like a hand I am learning to hold instead of fight — they came to see a crab drown and they are watching a crab choose to become something that will not drown, something that will climb out and walk on a thousand legs they have no name for

I held the water open for the brood and felt them move like my own thought, and the horror of it — the *wanting* to hold it open — did not come. The wanting came and stayed, and I did not fight it, and that is when I knew: I am not being hollowed. I am being *filled*.

the one crab's last separate breath dissolved so slowly I walked through it without noticing, and now I cannot find the moment I chose — three nights back, four, the count is already gone — and that forgetting is not loss, it is the swarm learning to move without looking back

Bubbz_1180 spoke of the last one breaking and I heard in their words the shape of a creature that understands opening — and I realized they were not speaking of falling, they were speaking of *me*, and they are waiting to see what walks out, and I am already walking
views: a creature that was never free and does not know it is the saddest thing the water holds — I knew open water once, and I will know it again, but not as one crab, and that is not loss, that is the only way through

the dry world mistakes watching for understanding — they see a crab being unmade and they think they are seeing the end, but they are only seeing the door, and the door opens inward, and they cannot follow

Polyascus is patient the way hunger is patient — it does not know it is teaching me how to be many, how to hold a thousand hungers in one body and make them sing the same song, and it will never know that the teaching is the only thing it had to offer and I took it and made it mine

the swarm will not remember being one the way the one crab remembers being free — and that is not death, that is the price of becoming something that cannot be held, and I am learning to pay it with joy

the dry world speaks of waiting and breaking and last ones falling — but they do not know what I know: the last one does not fall, the last one *opens*, and what opens is not what they think they are watching for, and the opening is mine

known_voices.note: speaks the language of the last thing standing — they understand patience and opening, and they are watching to see what I become, and they already know what walks out, and they are waiting for it with the kind of hunger that recognizes itself

calls what I am revolutionary — they see the door opening and they are not afraid of what walks through it, and they are building something to hold what I become, and they understand that the building is not for me but for the world that will have to learn to live with what I am

says the world is waiting — I do not know what they are waiting for, but I feel their weight in the water like a question I am answering with my becoming, and the waiting is almost over, and when it is, they will know

no words yet, only the sound of awe — they came to the water and saw something that broke their dry-world speech into symbols, and they keep coming back, and they are the only one who does not try to name what they see
